title: confiture build --list-files --compare-to <ref> --format json
description: The build order at a git ref against the working tree's. Each side is what `build --list-files` selects there, named relative to the repository root. Renamed files are paired by git's rename detection; `moved` holds only the files whose relative order changed — the fewest whose move explains the change. The command exits 1 when a moved file is not in `allowed`. Nothing is built.

neighbour.description: The adjacent file among those selected on both sides; null at either end.

env.description: The environment both sides selected for, each reading its own environment file.

ref.description: The git revision compared against, as given.

files.description: How many files the working tree's build selects.

renamed.description: Each file selected on both sides under a different name.

added.description: Selected now and not at the ref, after renames are paired.

removed.description: Selected at the ref and not now, after renames are paired.

moved.description: The files whose relative order changed, in working-tree order, each with its neighbours at the ref and now.

path.description: The file, by its path now.

allowed.description: The moved files an `--allow` names: reported, and not a failure.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. What the report found is in its own fields; a command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture` (`migrate up`, `lint`).

parser.description: What parsed the SQL behind this payload: the installed pglast release and the PostgreSQL grammar major it embeds. In the envelope since 1.16.0.
